Body mein *male hormones (androgens)* ka level badh jata hai, jiski wajah se ovaries mein eggs ka development aur release *(ovulation)* properly nahi ho pata.
Body insulin ko effectively use nahi kar pati jisse insulin ka level badh jata hai. High insulin *Male Hormone* ki production ko aur badha sakta hai, jisse hormone imbalance aur zyada ho sakta hai.
*Hormonal imbalance* ke karan periods irregular ho sakte hain, ovaries mein chhote-chhote cysts ban sakte hain, aur *fertility* par bhi asar pad sakta hai.
